video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | John Collins

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins discusses the importance of not taking business decisions personally in the NBA.
quotes.excerpt: One thing that I continually understand more and more is to just not take it personal.
quotes.quote: One thing that I continually understand more and more is to just not take it personal. You know it is a business at the end of the day and trying to just separate what is business and what is real. And you know that is also what I try to lead to our young guys, is to just try to separate the two. But when you come into the gym man, you lock all the way in and you work and you try to just like I said, use that to build a stronger mind. There is going to be a lot of stuff that you cannot control in this league and you know it starts early if you can block out the noise.
quotes.social_post: John Collins on the mental side of the NBA, One thing that I continually understand more and more is to just not take it personal. It is a business at the end of the day.

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins says his move to the Detroit Pistons was a mutual decision.
quotes.excerpt: You guys are trying to do something that I agree with in my soul
quotes.quote: It was mutual. It was definitely a mutual energy coming from both ways. You know obviously have a great group here. Got guys like Cade, Jalen, previously before trying to build a great group of guys. And you know when I got that call from Trey, I was delighted to hear from it and I said you know let us start something. You guys are trying to do something that I agree with in my soul and that increases me basketball wise. So, it kind of came together very fast as you said, but you know to me that is a good sign.
quotes.social_post: John Collins on his move to the Detroit Pistons, It was definitely a mutual energy coming from both ways. You guys are trying to do something that I agree with in my soul.

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins names Rasheed Wallace and Isiah Thomas as his favorite Detroit Pistons players.
quotes.excerpt: It is probably a toss up between Sheed Wallace or Isaiah Thomas.
quotes.quote: It is probably a toss up between Sheed Wallace or Isaiah Thomas. That is Zeke of course. I had a chance to talk with Zeke when in Atlanta. You know he was always in the Turner Studios down in Atlanta. So my first time down there, you know he put me on game, you know trying to give me some words of wisdom and ever since then we have been great. So shout out to those two. Haven't talked to Sheed yet, but you know it is just love, just love from over here.
quotes.social_post: John Collins names his favorite Detroit Pistons players of all time, It is probably a toss up between Sheed Wallace or Isaiah Thomas.
